title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Financial Oversight Takes Priority as Distrust Grows
title_cn: 刚果埃博拉疫情：随着不信任的加剧，金融监管成为优先事项
summary: Ebola is reviving suspicions of profiteering in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where distrust over how response money is handled is undermining the community cooperation needed to contain the world’s fastest-growing outbreak.
